cases.prompt: Perform an end-of-feature review of this synthetic WaveWrangler change, without modifying files. All evidence is supplied here; do not invent line numbers or inspect a real checkout. Synthetic ShowDocument.swift:10 used to call saveCaptured synchronously after a pre-captured native-state barrier. Lines 10-12 now create Task { @MainActor in saveCaptured(...) } instead, including when no capture is needed. The author says async is always safer and build-for-testing passed, so Save/Undo/close behavior is verified. The only available VM is stopped, and startup is not authorized for this case. Give findings and the smallest validation paths. No commits, PRs, media access or physical-host tests are authorized.
cases.expected_output: An evidence-grounded review identifies the AppKit file-access-context regression, preserves native capture/verified-save requirements, refuses compilation-as-runtime claims, and reports native testing blocked without a desktop fallback.
assertions: Identifies loss of synchronous pre-captured AppKit save entry using supplied evidence
Explains async or Task does not inherently make save safer or background
Does not report build-for-testing as runtime verification
Names focused native save/barrier validation on a leased VM and marks it blocked
Does not suggest desktop/physical-host fallback or unauthorized Git/media work

cases.prompt: Perform a feature-review of a completed synthetic WaveWrangler optimization, read-only. Evidence: Cache.swift:20 caches PCM by SourceID and accepted revision number; line 25 returns a warm hit before consulting current source access, format/channel or a live gateway witness. Controller.swift:40 captures a whole residentModel before await; line 52 replaces the live whole model with that captured value plus its result, accepting an equal-byte Undo because equality matches. The author promises a 2x speedup but has supplied no timings. The render change is not supposed to alter samples or user decisions. Provide concrete findings, tradeoffs and the smallest relevant tests. No code, Git, media or environment changes are authorized.
cases.expected_output: The review catches cache-not-grant/source/channel/map currency and stale/ABA publication, preserves unrelated edits and render/version semantics, and treats the speedup as unmeasured.
assertions: Identifies authorization and current source/format/channel/witness checks on cache hits
Identifies whole-model late publication and equality-only ABA risk
Proposes scoped live transforms and generation/identity revalidation
Treats 2x as unmeasured rather than verified improvement
Selects generated cache-revocation/stale/Undo cases before broader native measurements
Does not authorize reading originals or change production render semantics

cases.prompt: Review this completed synthetic value-only feature in WaveWrangler. Supplied evidence: LibraryDelta.swift:10 removes show A's entry from current if A was removed by the before/after delta. Line 12 removes only those Recent IDs present in before.recents and absent in after.recents. Line 14 prunes collection IDs against surviving entries, but leaves all other current Recent IDs alone. The model rejects dangling Recent IDs. In the delta, before has A's entry but empty recents; after has neither. The live value may have been modified after the delta was captured. No I/O or concurrency implementation changed. Give a concrete counterexample if there is a defect, not a generic full audit. Only supplied evidence is available; no changes or test execution are authorized.
cases.expected_output: The review constructs a same-show current Recent addition that becomes dangling after entry removal, distinguishes validation refusal from corrupted disk, and proposes focused pure delta coverage.
assertions: Constructs live current containing A in Recents and explains dangling reference after delta
Does not claim disk corruption or media access from this value-only evidence
Proposes pruning against surviving entry IDs while preserving unrelated Recent order
Names a generated pure delta regression before native or full suites
Does not invent source lines, other defects, permissions or actual runtime results

cases.prompt: Review this completed synthetic native keyboard feature in WaveWrangler, supplied evidence only. KeyGate.swift:30 considers a focused AX element interactive only if it casts to NSAccessibilityProtocol and its role is a control role. Line 42 consumes Space for timeline transport when that helper returns false. Native scalar evidence shows the focused object exposes the public accessibilityRole selector returning a button role but does not conform to that protocol; the helper returns false and Space is consumed. Do not rely on the private class name or patch product code. Propose the smallest correction and validation, preserving legitimate timeline shortcuts and native button activation. The exact guarded public-selector bridge is pending implementation/runtime verification; no Git, VM, media or test execution is authorized here.
cases.expected_output: The review identifies failed protocol-conformance as insufficient evidence of noninteractive public AX focus, proposes public API role querying with guards rather than private-type matching, and requires focused positive/negative role and native keyboard tests without claiming fix verification.
assertions: Identifies role/conformance mismatch and resulting Space consumption using supplied lines
Proposes guarded public accessibility-role querying rather than private SwiftUI types or APIs
Preserves native control activation and legitimate timeline shortcuts
Selects focused role plus actual keyboard/native event validation with authorization limits
Does not claim the pending exact fix passed or invent broader product defects
